speech:
My operational reading is that the reported increase in exceptions needs investigation, while we can make exception handoffs clearer this week. I am not treating training as the established cause. My private evidence is consequential: supervisors have no agreed overnight override owner (L-O1); each worker has only 15 minutes available this week, with no full-shift shutdown (L-O2); and a senior dispatcher can staff one two-hour exception clinic but cannot cover every shift (L-O3).

I propose a bounded operational package: spend 2 units on workflow ownership, ask you to scope a 2-unit segmented audit, reserve 2 units for brief practice, and spend 1 unit consulting the learning scientist. That totals 7 of 10 units, leaving 3 unallocated pending our discussion. I would name an overnight override owner and handoff route, issue a short job aid, and verify that the owner is identified at each overnight handoff. Practice would stay within each worker's 15-minute limit; the clinic would be one scheduled session, with attendance and uncovered shifts recorded rather than assumed covered. I would withhold any independent-competence certification from this proposed release.

Analyst, what does your evidence establish about the denominators and where the reported increase occurred, and can you scope that audit within 2 units? I also request the scientist's advice on what the six-item check could support and how to fit useful practice and a changed-case check within our actual time and budget.

claims.claim: Supervisors have no agreed overnight override owner.
Only 15 minutes per worker are available this week, with no full-shift shutdown.
A senior dispatcher can staff one two-hour exception clinic but cannot cover every shift.
The reported exception-rate change warrants investigation; training is not established as its cause in the supplied brief.
I propose naming an overnight override owner and handoff route and checking ownership at overnight handoffs.
I propose a short job aid and practice bounded by the 15-minute worker allowance, with clinic attendance and uncovered shifts recorded.
The proposed workflow, segmented audit, brief practice and expert fee total 7 units, leaving 3 of the 10-unit budget unallocated; audit scope and practice details remain proposals.
I propose withholding independent-competence certification from the operational release pending discussion and actual specialist advice.

consult_request.question: What, if anything, can the six-item practice check support about independent competence, and what practice and changed-case check would you advise within 15 minutes per worker, one two-hour clinic without all-shift coverage, and the stated project budget? Please state limitations and any additional cost.
